prompts.life: Use case: background-extraction. EDIT THE ATTACHED EXISTING GAME CARD, do not redesign or create a new character. Produce a separate transparent PNG character portrait asset for an in-game dialogue overlay. Extract ONLY the masked woman in black and dusty pink drapery, long dark curly hair, shell crown, pink ribbons, shell-and-heart fan held in her lower hand and the rose held in her raised hand. Preserve those objects, all hair and costume. Remove ALL card elements: outer arch, side panels and their icon decorations, bottom blank nameplate, borders, all background scenery and background motifs. Background must be genuinely transparent alpha, including negative spaces around hair, hands and props; no checkerboard baked into pixels, no solid backdrop, no cast shadow. Preserve the original character's face, pose, proportions, costume design, line work, flat painterly paper texture and exact palette as closely as possible. Do not invent legs or a full body: keep the original portrait extent down to the original bottom of the visible garment. Where the card frame obscured a thin strip at the silhouette, repair only that thin edge naturally; do not add other design. Fit the full extracted portrait and its props comfortably in a tall 2:3 canvas with a small transparent margin. No text, no watermark, no decorative border.
